pCloud is a Swiss cloud storage provider subject to Swiss data privacy laws, making it a strong choice for privacy-conscious applications. The backend supports both US and EU API endpoints for data residency requirements.
pCloud uses OAuth 2.0. Your app is responsible for completing the OAuth flow and obtaining an access token. Pass the token when creating the file system:
